text:
sam: Heads up — hitting a mypy error when using the async Python SDK in an `async with` context. Stubs don't show `__aenter__` / `__aexit__` on AsyncClient so typechecker complains.

maria: ugh. can you paste a tiny repro?

sam: yep. minimal:```py
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key=...) as c:  # mypy: "AsyncClient" has no attribute "__aenter__"
        await c.generate("hi")
```

maria: that helps. runtime works fine right? it's only a typing issue?

sam: runtime is fine, it's strictly the .pyi/.stubs we ship. mypy 1.6 rejects it. pyright also flags it. :facepalm:

raj: think the generator emits `class AsyncClient:` without async context manager dunders. We probably only added `close()` and `__aexit__` on the sync client.

lee: quick workaround: annotate with `typing.cast(Any, AsyncClient(...))` or avoid `async with` (ugh). better to add `async def __aenter__(self) -> "AsyncClient": ...` & `async def __aexit__(...) -> None` in the stub.

maria: adding to generator seems right. Also need to ensure return type for `__aenter__` is the proper Self/AsyncClient so `async with` binds name correctly.

raj: agree. another twist: our auth middleware exposes `refresh_token` as a coroutine on the client, but stubs mark it as `Callable[..., None]` — so callers `await client.auth.refresh_token()` are flagged. I can include that fix in the same generator patch.

sam: nice — two problems in one. Can we also make sure the streaming API stub types an `AsyncIterator[bytes]` instead of `AsyncIterator[Any]`? It's causing a bunch of downstream mypy noise in sample apps.

lee: yes, streaming chunk type should be a concrete dataclass/TypedDict we generate, not Any. We'll need to update the shape generator to emit TypedDict definitions and re-use them in the iterator signature.

maria: plan proposal: (1) generator: add proper async context manager dunders on AsyncClient, (2) fix auth refresh typing to be `async def refresh_token(...) -> str`, (3) make stream iterator type explicit with generated TypedDict or dataclass, (4) run mypy/pyright in CI on sample apps to catch regressions.

raj: I'm +1. I'll open a PR to the autogen repo. cc @devex-bot to add a quick test that compiles stubs with mypy.

devex-bot: created issue #412: "async client stubs: context-manager + auth + stream typing" and assigned to raj. CI job mypy-sampleapp added to pipeline.

sam: thanks! one more micro-request — can the stubs include `typing.Self` where appropriate (client methods that return self) to play nicely with pyright?

lee: yep, Self is easy for py3.11+. We'll default to `typing.Self` and fall back to the explicit class name when generating for older compat targets.

maria: awesome. If anyone wants a quick pairing session on the generator changes let me know — I'd like to make sure the TypedDict format matches the SDK docs.

sam: I'll help test against our customer's sampleapp that surfaced this. thanks all :heart:
